figurative_meaning_en: Unusually excessive or one too many
example_sentences_in_bangla: পার্টিতে বারোর মধ্যে তেরো লোক এসে পড়েছে।
এই ঘরে বারোর মধ্যে তেরো জিনিস ভর্তি করে রাখা হয়েছে।
example_sentences_in_english: There were thirteen people showing up for a party meant for twelve.
The room is crammed with thirteen items in a space for twelve.
note: This idiom draws from the idea of an extra number beyond the standard count, common in South Asian linguistic traditions.
